sources.entry: 4. Microsoft Azure Cognitive Services - AI APIs for speech, vision, and language.

summary.name: Foundry Tools
summary.one_liner: Microsoft Azure's suite of prebuilt, fully managed AI APIs for vision, speech, language, translation, content understanding, and document intelligence, formerly known as Azure AI services or Azure Cognitive Services.
use_cases: Build voice agents with speech-to-text and text-to-speech
Extract text and tables from scanned documents
Translate documents and text across 100+ languages
Add OCR and image analysis to apps
Summarize documents and analyze text sentiment
Add prebuilt AI features to apps and agents without data science expertise
summary.what_it_does: Foundry Tools is a collection of ready-to-use APIs that Microsoft describes as giving agents the ability to act on data. The page lists six tool areas: Vision, Speech, Language, Translator, Content Understanding, and Document Intelligence. Vision covers OCR, image analysis, and face detection. Document Intelligence extracts text, key-value pairs, tables, and structures from documents. Translator covers text and document translation across more than 100 languages. The services are offered through studios, SDKs, and APIs and are part of the unified Microsoft Foundry platform, which also includes models from Microsoft, OpenAI, Meta, and Cohere.
notable: Renamed from Azure AI services / Azure Cognitive Services and part of Microsoft Foundry
Covers Vision, Speech, Language, Translator, Content Understanding, and Document Intelligence
Lower barrier to entry than Azure Machine Learning, aimed at general developers rather than data scientists
caveats: Consumption-based pricing; each service has its own pricing options, and specific prices are not listed on the page
Requires an Azure account; free trial stated as up to 30 days
Pricing details are not given on this page
